description: This file defines a utility function 'formatLabel' that formats string labels (usually object keys) into human-friendly display labels, handling snake_case to Title Case conversion, acronym recognition, and immutability. It exports 'formatLabel' as a named export and sets 'formatLabel' as the default export.

methods.name: formatLabel(key)
methods.description: Converts snake_case or underscored labels into Title Case with spaces, handling common acronyms and ensuring data is not mutated.
